title: Oxva Xlim Classic Pod Vape Kit
description: The Oxva Xlim Classic Pod Kit combines sleek, ergonomic design with impressive features, making it ideal for both new and experienced adult vapers. Powered by a 1000mAh built-in battery, this compact pod system delivers up to 30W of power, providing plenty of vaping satisfaction in a portable and stylish device. The fast USB-C charging ensures minimal downtime, allowing you to vape all day without worrying about battery life. The Xlim Classic is compatible with Oxva's XLIM Top Fill and XLIM V2 refillable pods, offering 2ml of e-liquid capacity and multiple coil resistances (0.6ohm and 0.8ohm included) to suit both nicotine salts and freebase e-liquids. This versatility allows you to switch between MTL and RDL vaping styles with ease, with the rich, authentic flavour that OXVA pods are famous for. Its top-fill system makes refilling quick and hassle-free, while the precise airflow control lets you fine-tune your draw for a more personal vaping experience. The device features dual activation modes, meaning you can vape using either auto-draw or button-activation for added convenience. A 0.42" OLED screen on the device displays essential information, such as power output, puff count, and battery status, ensuring you're always in control of your vape. Crafted from lightweight aluminium alloy with a sleek and minimalist design, the Oxva Xlim Classic is available in several vibrant colours, so you can choose a device that suits your style. Whether you're looking for a powerful, compact pod kit or just something sleek for on-the-go vaping, the Xlim Classic delivers on all fronts. Discover vape liquids online crafted to pair seamlessly with this kit. We recommend using 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquid with the pods in this kit. Oxva Xlim Topfill pod 0.6ohm - use 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquid. Oxva Xlim Topfill pod 0.8ohm - use 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquid. Please note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
